notes:
{恋人|こいびと} refers to a romantic partner. It is gender-neutral and slightly more literary or formal than ⟦{彼氏|かれし}→彼氏：06456_kareshi⟧/⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {恋人|こいびと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to get a boyfriend/girlfriend
- {恋人|こいびと}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{別|わか}れる→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧: to break up with one's partner
- {恋人|こいびと}⟦{同士|どうし}→同士：03474_doushi⟧: as a couple, between lovers
- {恋人|こいびと}⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧: seeking a partner (in ads)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{彼氏|かれし}→彼氏：06456_kareshi⟧: boyfriend (casual, everyday)
- ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧: girlfriend (casual, everyday)
- ⟦パートナー→パートナー：11287_paatonaa⟧: partner (modern, gender-neutral)
- ⟦{愛人|あいじん}→愛人：22539_aijin⟧: lover (implies extramarital or secret relationship — do not confuse with {恋人|こいびと})

REGISTER:
Used in both spoken and written Japanese. In casual conversation, ⟦{彼氏|かれし}→彼氏：06456_kareshi⟧/⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧ is more common; {恋人|こいびと} has a slightly romantic or literary feel.
